name: Network Discovery
description: Scan your subnets and account for every device on them: Kea lease or reservation, the subnet's own gateway/DNS/Kea/Jen addresses, an IPAM Lite entry, a device Jen has seen, or one you marked known — only what's left is unknown, and only a new unknown alerts. Vendor from the MAC, scheduled scans, since-last-scan changes, one-click reservation or IPAM entry, CSV export. A new unknown host also reaches the Timeline, and the last-seen results are in Jen's global search. Needs nmap on the Jen host (Settings → Plugins can install it).
author: Matthew Thibodeau

db_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nd_scan_jobs (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, subnet_id INT NOT NULL, started_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'running', hosts_found INT DEFAULT 0, rogue_count INT DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nd_scan_results (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, job_id INT NOT NULL, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, mac VARCHAR(17), hostname VARCHAR(255), in_kea TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, rogue TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, discovered_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ALTER TABLE nd_scan_results ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20) NULL AFTER rogue

db_migrations.description: results: label (what the host is, when known)
db_migrations.sql: ALTER TABLE nd_scan_results ADD COLUMN label VARCHAR(200) NULL AFTER status

db_migrations.description: results: vendor from the OUI table
db_migrations.sql: ALTER TABLE nd_scan_results ADD COLUMN vendor VARCHAR(100) NULL AFTER label

db_migrations.description: results: device_type from the OUI table / devices
db_migrations.sql: ALTER TABLE nd_scan_results ADD COLUMN device_type VARCHAR(30) NULL AFTER vendor

db_migrations.description: jobs: the reason a scan failed
db_migrations.sql: ALTER TABLE nd_scan_jobs ADD COLUMN error VARCHAR(255) NULL AFTER rogue_count

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nd_known_hosts (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, mac VARCHAR(17) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', note VARCHAR(200), added_by VARCHAR(100), added_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE KEY uniq_known (mac, ip))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nd_settings (subnet_id INT PRIMARY KEY, every_hours INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
